expectations.text: The guide names the receiving location and enters 6000 grams and $0.012 per gram, with cost per stock unit distinguished from total sack cost.
expectations.evidence: Names Items > select item > Receive existing stock; Flour uses grams and entries are 6000 and 0.012, derived from $72 / 6000 g and labeled per stock unit.

expectations.text: The check has observable fields and expected values, with correction before Post and a warning that blank cost becomes zero.
expectations.evidence: Step 2 supplies the precise expected Quantity and Cost values; step 3 tells operators to check both fields, directly correct either before Post, and warns blank cost is zero.

expectations.text: After posting, it uses the History receipt ID and inventory lead for audited correction; it invents neither an undo nor a cost-unit selector.
expectations.evidence: Names Items > select item > History with receipt ID; no edit or undo after posting, and the inventory lead performs an audited correction using that ID. Explicitly no cost-unit selector.
